body: claimed: Codex (m3) · 2026-11-15T13:25:59.947325+00:00 · branch mkinney:issue/1881-waterjet-kinds · plan: stack on #1811 and add waterjet machine, tool, cut-data and machine-check seams with refusal pins.

Stopped after the second gate attempt.

The waterjet implementation is held locally in .claude/worktrees/issue-1881 on branch issue/1881-waterjet-kinds.
The branch starts at PR #1811 head 73b64e71fc1f6259f247537d1c61d64db4ed304f.
The changes are not committed or pushed.

The first parser pin failed on unchanged code because waterjet was an unknown machine kind.
All 28 new issue pins now pass.
All 69 behavioral mutation checks failed with the mutation and passed after restoration.
Two of those checks restored actual upstream files before restoring the fix.
The workspace all-targets compile check passed.
Clippy passed with -D warnings for camcraft-app, camcraft-post, camcraft-tools and camcraft-ui.

The first full quick gate found an outdated allowed-kind assertion and a shared tool icon.
Both are fixed and their targeted tests pass.
The waterjet now has an original SVG master and its own product icon.
The icon master check passes.

The second quick gate, restricted to the remaining UI step, fails only headless_run_succeeds and headless_cli_exit_code_is_zero.
Both fail because wgpu reports no graphics adapter.
Metal exposes no adapter in this environment and has no software fallback here.
No GPU tests were skipped or weakened.

This issue changes no NC or CL golden.
The 21 direct upstream golden differences all match the unchanged #1811 stack parent.

I am releasing the claim under the requested two-failure stop rule.
A session with a graphics adapter can resume the local worktree, finish validation and open the draft PR.
